subject.title: [Bug]: 2 codex accounts, same machine, same docs, one has balloon startup cost

question: Should local Codex stdio `CODEX_HOME` become account-scoped by `authProfileId`, and if so should existing per-agent state be migrated, intentionally reset, or cleaned up by doctor/docs?
rationale: The source path supports the bug, but the fix changes where existing users' native Codex auth, sessions, plugins, caches, and diagnostics live, so automation should not choose the upgrade semantics alone.

options.title: Account-scope with upgrade plan
options.body: Approve account-scoped Codex homes and require doctor/docs/proof to explain or handle existing per-agent state before landing.

options.title: Keep per-agent storage
options.body: Preserve the current per-agent storage contract and investigate another source for the cached-prefix divergence.

options.title: Accept documented reset
options.body: Allow account-scoped homes to start empty for existing users, but require the reset tradeoff and cleanup path to be explicit in docs and PR evidence.

recommendation.title: Account-scope with upgrade plan
recommendation.body: Approve account-scoped Codex homes and require doctor/docs/proof to explain or handle existing per-agent state before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the central Codex OAuth ownership work and has recent blame in the implicated startup files, making them the best available routing candidate for the storage-boundary decision.
